title: Expose deployment action path in Settings
summary: Make the Settings surface show an obvious Start, Verify, Repair guidance, and Launch path for first-run deployment.
reason: Deployment review found that non-developer operators can open the app and see internal settings panels before a clear deployment path. The UI needs a compact entry strip that routes setup and verification through existing backend-owned actions without inventing frontend repair behavior.
behavior_before: Settings has Guided Setup and Validate Current Settings actions, but the first-run path is split across panels and does not present Start, Verify, Repair guidance, and Launch as a single operator sequence.
behavior_after: Settings Status now exposes a compact Deployment Path strip with Start Setup, Verify Settings, Repair Guidance, and Open Launch. The buttons open Guided Setup, invoke the existing backend settings validator, show read-only repair guidance focused on Config Health/Reload From Disk, and navigate to Launch readiness without adding new mutation routes.
tests_added: Static WebView coverage asserts the Settings Deployment Path strip is visible and wired only to existing backend-owned validation/navigation hooks.
Static WebView coverage asserts Repair Guidance does not call save, wizard save, pipeline start, or any direct API POST.
manual_validation: git diff --check for MP-CHANGE-2026-0613-011 touched paths - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Settings deployment action strip markup, event wiring, focused tests, summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Repair must remain guidance/recovery-only unless a backend-owned repair route exists. Do not add frontend filesystem mutation, direct config writes, launch/start behavior, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, or source/scratch/output mutation.
